impact: Dell's AI server orders and any comments on memory costs are the read-through for MU, DRAM and SNXX, and for neocloud demand at NBIS.
summary: Tuesday's earnings slate: Best Buy, Analog Devices (options imply about a 7.5% move), Dollar Tree and Burlington report before the open; Dell, Autodesk, Workday and HP report after the close. Best Buy guided comps up 1% to 3%, and higher memory prices could lift its product costs.
title: Dell, Workday, HP report after close; Best Buy, ADI before open
